promise: The adopted AI Act scheduled general-purpose AI model obligations to apply from August 2, 2025.
description: The Council adopted the AI Act on May 21, 2024. The Commission identifies August 2, 2025 as the application date for GPAI obligations, subject to the Act's transitional provisions.
evidence: The Council's dated adoption notice establishes the legislative milestone.
The Commission confirms the GPAI application date; this does not imply every provider faced identical immediate enforcement.
